title: Tata Power Company Ltd — Press Release
text: Tata Power Company Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 31, 2026, titled "Tata Power Renewables Utility Portfolio Scales to 12.3 GW; Surpasses 7 GW Operational Capacity with Commissioning of 100 MW Project at Kayathar, Tamil Nadu".
